selection: Use the fixed final update from all five epochs. No tuning or checkpoint selection on towns 40/41.
control: The unchanged Phase 2 temporal best checkpoint, FP32 native 256x128. Both paths use the same frozen backbone features, causal history, view and tick. Only B enables the learned predicted-depth projection branch.
gate: On the chase camera of each of towns 40 and 41 separately, B must increase signed aligned silhouette contrast on visible vehicle boundaries, and must not increase either static warped RGB-residual flicker or RGB L1 on newly vacated surfaces. Require measured pixels for all three. Compare unrounded pooled pixel sums. Only a validation pass releases the four fresh 32-second runs.
silhouette: Horizontal/vertical neighbors, both currently visible, exactly one labeled vehicle, mean absolute true RGB change at least 0.10. Sum predicted gradient dotted with true gradient divided by true gradient energy.
stability: Use consecutive 10Hz frames within each episode and view. Match static surfaces using the existing Phase 2 correspondence. Flicker is mean absolute change in prediction-minus-teacher RGB. Vacated error is RGB L1 on current static pixels occluded by a nearer vehicle or pedestrian in the previous frame.
media: For each town save the complete chase movie and a crop at the time with the largest currently visible vehicle component, selected using teacher labels only.
